hero.tagline: Your time is too precious to waste on thankless tasks.

pain.title: The problem
pain.item1_title: You're burning out on tasks that have nothing to do with cooking.
pain.item1_desc: Staff management, menu updates, accounting, review replies, reservations, supplier orders.
pain.item2_title: Technology can eliminate them — but no one has done it simply and affordably.
pain.item2_desc: Existing software is either too generic, too expensive, or too complex to adopt.
pain.item3_desc: Precise tools, built for your operation, deployed in days.

solution.title: Jukely automates your thankless tasks.
solution.item1_desc: Not generic software — yours. Built for your team, not an average. Delivered in days, not months.
solution.item2_desc: We charge for what we do. Not what the market tolerates. You know exactly what you pay and why.
solution.item3_desc: Done. It's automatic. You get back every minute you used to spend on it. Back to the heart of your craft.

process.title: How it works
process.step1_desc: First conversation to identify your main time sinks and how we can help optimise your operation.
process.step2_desc: We develop a custom tool for your restaurant, not generic software. You review at every step.
process.step3_desc: We come to you, install everything, train your team in one hour. That's it.
